input_requirement: The system shall generate a report at the end of each day.

ambiguities.fragment: at the end of each day
ambiguities.explanation: The phrase 'end of each day' is ambiguous due to polysemy in the word 'day'. It can refer either to a calendar day (24-hour period) or a working day (business day). Each interpretation imposes a different frequency on when the report should be generated.
possible_interpretations: The system generates a report at 23:59 of each calendar day, regardless of whether it is a weekend or holiday.
The system generates a report at the end of each working day (e.g., 17:00), which may not coincide with the calendar day boundary.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: at the end of each day
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: The system generates a report at 23:59 of each calendar day, regardless of whether it is a weekend or holiday.
evidence_from_requirement: The glossary defines 'report' as an Automated daily summary of processed transactions, which implies a connection to the calendar day boundary (23:59).
evidence_from_context: Business rule BR-01 specifies delivery to the report archive within 5 minutes of generation, implying a focus on calendar days for reporting purposes.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The glossary definition and business rule BR-01 support the interpretation that 'end of each day' refers to the calendar day boundary.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall generate a report at 23:59 of each calendar day, regardless of whether it is a weekend or holiday.
structuring_notes: AMB-01 resolved: ambiguous fragment 'at the end of each day' replaced with supported interpretation.
